title: Fleet = targets.yaml loader + sequential orchestration over the same audit core
rationale: trellis-6eb1 builds src/fleet/ as three modules + barrel: targets.ts (strict zod schema + loadFleet, path-resolution relative to the targets.yaml dir, duplicate-id guard, TargetsError) and the pure targetAuditOptions() WHAT→audit seam mapping a ResolvedTarget+defaults onto AuditOptions; orchestrate.ts runFleet() audits each target sequentially via the SAME core auditRepo (audit+drift), persists each run, and computes a level delta by reading store.latestRun(id) BEFORE insertRun; report.ts renders terminal/md (json is the FleetReport itself). Per-target failures (missing path, audit throw) isolate into ok:false entries — the fleet never aborts. To make this work, auditRepo gained repoId (stamps report.repo + drift.repo + cache key so central state keys on the targets.yaml id, not basename), skip (forces criteria not-applicable with rationale SKIPPED_VIA_TARGETS), and osecoDetectors (plumbed onto DetectionContext, default-on, forward-compat for trellis-7f70); driftRepo gained repoId. defaults.investigation maps to investigateOpts.targetDefaults. Orchestrator takes injectable store/audit/pathExists/now for offline determinism. auditRepo was refactored (scoreAllCriteria + foldDrift + deterministicEntry helpers) to stay under the cognitive-complexity ratchet after the additions.

title: Dogfood gate (trellis-a534): fleet of trellis + 7 warren-stack repos all complete end-to-end; determinism verified byte-identical
rationale: Built a real targets.yaml (gitignored, operator paths) for trellis,warren,burrow,plot,mulch,seeds,canopy,sapling. Fixing the Pi version-probe (stderr) unblocked investigation, lifting trellis self-audit L3->L4 (coverage 56%->78%). Fleet run: 8 ok / 0 error; trellis L4 drift0, warren/burrow/plot/mulch/seeds/canopy L4, sapling L3 (honest: pr 58%). Two consecutive runs at unchanged commits are byte-identical per repo (excluding scoredAt + the run-relative changesSinceLastRun) — second run hit the investigation_cache (no LLM calls), every repo Δ=0. Triage of the 16 remaining no-detector criteria (app-scope observability+security, e.g. distributed_tracing, dast_scanning, api_schema_docs): case (b) genuinely-missing app-runtime adapters — left counted, no dishonest N/A; non-skippable ones cannot be N/A per SPEC §3.2 anyway. trellis bands L4 honestly without skips.
